source_repairs.what: First1KGreek encodes Lake's Latin for chapters 10-12, the end of 13 and 14 in Greek letters (e.g. 'ξονφιδο ενιμ' = 'confido enim'), with OCR slips. Restored to Latin letters by fixed letter mapping, then every word compared across three witnesses (that file and two independent Internet Archive OCRs of Lake); 17 single-word OCR slips settled by majority (e.g. alterntri->alterutri, babebitis->habebitis, dorninum->dominum, Crescentum/Crescentem->Crescentem). These sections now use the key 'latin'.
